title: This Bird Flies for Two Months and Sleeps in 12-Second Bursts
subject: great frigatebird

scenes.text: A bird that can stay in the air for two months. When does it sleep?
The great frigatebird can fly over the ocean without landing, up to two months.
Researchers fitted 14 of them with brain monitors to find out.
In the air, it naps in bursts of about 12 seconds, often with only half its brain asleep.
That adds up to roughly 40 minutes of sleep a day. On land, they sleep about 12 hours.
Forty minutes a day, in 12-second bursts, over open ocean.

description:
A bird that can stay in the air for two months.
Great frigatebirds nap for about 12 seconds at a time while flying, with around 40 minutes of sleep a day.
